entries.title: Panels on your iPhone and iPad can start a message and open Settings
entries.body: On the Panels tab of your iPhone and iPad, a panel's button that starts a message now puts its words in the message box on Home, unsent, as it does on your Mac. A button that opens Settings now opens the phone's Settings on that section, and on an automation's own page when it names one. A section the phone does not have opens nothing.
entries.noPicture: The panel and the Settings page it opens look as they did; what changed is that the tap now reaches them, which a still picture cannot show.
